summary: Living area is generally tidy but presents minor tip-over and rug trip concerns.

hazards.title: Tall Plant Tip-Over Hazard
hazards.detail: Tall potted plant in basket could tip over if bumped along the walkway.
fixSteps: Use a heavier base inside the basket to increase stability.
Shift plant away from the primary walkway edge.

hazards.title: Area Rug Edge Trip Risk
hazards.detail: Area rug edges sitting on hard flooring can lift or shift, causing trips.
fixSteps: Place non-slip rug grippers beneath the corners.
Ensure the rug lays completely flat against the floor.

hazards.title: Unanchored Credenza
hazards.detail: Heavy wall-adjacent console credenza is vulnerable to tipping if pulled.
fixSteps: Fasten furniture anti-tip safety straps to wall studs.
Keep heavy lamps and decor centered or towards the back.

products.name: Furniture Anti-Tip Wall Straps
products.reason: Secures console tables and credenzas firmly to wall studs.

products.reason: Prevents rug edges and corners from curling or shifting.
